# `cts_reassign_transport`

Change the owner of a transport request (optionally cascading to modifiable tasks).

Defined in [`packages/adt-mcp/src/lib/tools/cts-reassign-transport.ts`](https://github.com/abapify/adt-cli/blob/main/packages/adt-mcp/src/lib/tools/cts-reassign-transport.ts).

## Input schema

| Parameter         | Type      | Required | Description                                                             |
| ----------------- | --------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `baseUrl`         | `string`  | no       | SAP system base URL (e.g. https://host:8000)                            |
| `client`          | `string`  | no       | SAP client number                                                       |
| `username`        | `string`  | no       | Username for basic auth                                                 |
| `password`        | `string`  | no       | Password for basic auth                                                 |
| `systemId`        | `string`  | no       | Logical system id (resolved via multi-system config or ~/.adt sessions) |
| `transportNumber` | `string`  | yes      | Transport number (e.g. TRLK900123)                                      |
| `targetUser`      | `string`  | yes      | SAP username of the new owner                                           |
| `recursive`       | `boolean` | no       | Also reassign all modifiable tasks (default: false)                     |

## Output

The tool returns a single text content item whose body is a JSON-serialised object (`content[0].text`). On error, the response has `isError: true` and a human-readable message.

```json
{
  "content": [{ "type": "text", "text": "<JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)>" }]
}
```

See the source for the exact shape of `result`.

## Example invocation

```json
{
  "name": "cts_reassign_transport",
  "arguments": {
    "baseUrl": "https://sap.example.com:44300",
    "username": "DEVELOPER",
    "password": "***",
    "client": "100",
    "transportNumber": "<transportNumber>",
    "targetUser": "<targetUser>"
  }
}
```
